To [Hiring Manager],  

Nikhil and I have collaborated occasionally on cross-team SRE initiatives at [FAANG Company], where we’ve worked alongside CloudNexus on large-scale infrastructure projects. His expertise bridges cloud operations and automation, with a knack for turning complex challenges into streamlined solutions.  

Nikhil’s strength lies in his ability to architect CI/CD pipelines that scale reliably. During a recent project, he redesigned our deployment process, reducing mean time to deploy by 40% while slashing rollback frequency by half. His cloud cost optimization work stood out too—by re-evaluating spot instance usage and automating resource tagging, he cut monthly spend by $120K without compromising SLAs.  

I’ve seen him own GitHub Actions workflows that cut manual intervention in incident response by 70%, and his Terraform modules for Kubernetes clusters became a shared repo across three teams. His Prometheus/Grafana dashboards now power real-time monitoring for two critical services.  

Nikhil’s reliability is unmatched. He’ll often stay late to debug a flaky service or refactor legacy code into clean, maintainable systems. His curiosity drives him to master new tools, but his true value is in translating technical depth into team-wide impact.  

If you’re seeking someone who balances operational rigor with innovation, Nikhil is an exceptional choice.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
